model.name: Permit / Authorization
model.purpose: Represent the governed application, assessment and decision case for regulated authorization while keeping the permission-bearing grant in its authoritative external master.
model.scope_statement: Owns authorization-case identity, requested class and scope, submissions, evidence-use assertions, completeness, criterion assessments, consultations, decisions, reasons, notifications, appeal routes and follow-on administration cases. Applicants, authorities, legal instruments, public-service definitions, reusable criteria, evidence artifacts, payments, inspections, enforcement, appeals and granted rights remain external masters.
in_scope: Case identity, class, actors in procedural roles, service, legal basis and requested authorization scope
Application revisions, evidence-use, completeness, assessment, consultation, decision, reasons and notification
Follow-on renewal, variation, suspension or termination cases, access views, retention, interoperability and safe operations
out_of_scope: Permission-bearing permit, licence, authorization, credential or right master and its independently verified current status
Applicant, authority, legal instrument, public service, criterion, evidence artifact, payment, inspection, enforcement and appeal-case masters
Universal licensing law, legal advice or automated final decision without competent authority

boundary_notes.distinction: A favorable decision points to a separately mastered permission-bearing grant; case completion and grant validity are never interchangeable.
The reusable service definition supplies channels, requirements, outputs and legal resources; this model owns one execution case.
Reusable requirements and evidence artifacts keep external masters; the case owns submissions, supported claims, verification and assessment findings.
Inspections and enforcement actions may trigger or inform a case but retain their own authority, evidence and lifecycle.
Legal sources establish competence, requirements and effects; the authorization case applies them but does not own or reinterpret the law.

sources.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1463
sources.relevance: Sets technical and operational specifications for cross-border automated evidence exchange, including user request, preview, delivery, logging and data-protection controls.

sources.title: LegalRuleML Core Specification Version 1.0
sources.relevance: Defines legal sources, authority, jurisdiction, temporal characteristics and deontic effects useful for expressing requirements and permission decisions without creating substantive law.

sources.organization: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
sources.relevance: Lists the Fishing Licence, Authorization and Permit process among UN/CEFACT standards and establishes it as a sector interoperability profile rather than a universal permit lifecycle.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

sources.title: Time Ontology in OWL

functions.name: Open authorization case
functions.description: Create case identity, class, authority, service, legal basis, applicant roles and requested scope.
preconditions: competence, identity and service version validate
effects: case becomes resolvable without creating a grant

functions.name: Submit application revision
functions.description: Append signed declarations, requested scope, receipt and completeness context.
effects: immutable revision is recorded for review

functions.name: Attach and verify evidence
functions.description: Link external evidence or registry data to requirements and record a verification assertion.
effects: evidence use stays attributable and privacy-scoped

functions.name: Assess criterion
functions.description: Record method, evidence used, result, reasons, uncertainty and accountable reviewer for one criterion.
effects: finding contributes to review without becoming the final decision

functions.name: Request information or consultation
functions.description: Issue a cure, referral, consultation or inspection request and track the response deadline.
effects: review is paused or enriched with attributable input

functions.name: Issue reasoned decision
functions.description: Record grant, refusal, partial, defer, withdrawal, lapse or closure with authority, reasons and effect time.
preconditions: competence, due process, reasons and affected scope validate
effects: case outcome is fixed without itself creating a grant master

functions.name: Notify and bind grant reference
functions.description: Record decision delivery, publication, appeal route and any separately mastered authorization identifier.
preconditions: decision, recipient policy and external grant resolve
effects: parties can verify outcome without conflating case and grant

functions.name: Open follow-on administration case
functions.description: Create renewal, variation, transfer, suspension, revocation, annulment, surrender or reinstatement case.
preconditions: grant and jurisdictional identity-continuity rule resolve
effects: later action stays auditable and cannot mutate grant by inference

functions.name: Issue purpose-bound case view
functions.description: Create applicant, regulator, public, statistical or sector exchange projection with declared omissions.
preconditions: access, freshness and target version validate
effects: view links source digest, scope warning and omissions

functions.name: Close and retain case
functions.description: Close, lapse, withdraw, archive or tombstone the case while preserving decisions, appeals and grant references.
preconditions: appeal, legal hold and disposition authority validate
effects: active processing ends while citable history remains

composition.target: Criterion, Evidence, Payment, Inspection, Enforcement and Appeal Case models
composition.purpose: Connect case-specific use and findings to external requirement, artifact, financial, oversight and review masters.
Project public-service, requirement, evidence, output and participation bindings.
Project legal-source and permission semantics plus sector authorization messages with declared loss.

owner_package_requirements: Dimension identity, owner, authorization-case authority, rights-register authority and namespace
Service, requirement, evidence, application, assessment, decision, grant-reference, appeal and lifecycle registries
Master-system mappings for parties, authorities, legal instruments, grants, evidence, payments, inspections and enforcement
Competence, identity, requirements, evidence, reasons, due process, access, retention and agent-operation policies
dimension.namespace_guidance: Mint authorization-case identifiers only when no competent authority identity exists; keep applicants, authorities, legal sources, public services, criteria, evidence artifacts, payments, inspections, appeals, enforcement and grants as typed references.
registry_links: Dimension-local authorization-case, submission, assessment, decision, notification and follow-on action registries

canonicalization_rules: Canonicalize by competent-authority case identifier and register, never by applicant, permit number, requested activity, decision date, document or hash.
Keep authorization case, application revision, assessment, decision, notification and external permission-bearing grant separately identifiable.
patch_rules: Extensions declare jurisdiction and sector profile, target finding, legal source, authority, criterion and exchange-profile versions and interoperability impact.
Case identity, competence, requirement semantics, decision effect or grant-reference changes require a successor revision, migration map and retained cited history.
compatibility_rules: Unknown additive fields may be ignored only when identity, competence, requested scope, criteria, evidence links, reasons, legal times, appeal, access and provenance remain intact.
Every CPSV, CCCEV, LegalRuleML or sector projection pins versions and states transformed fields, omissions and round-trip limits.

identity_priority: Competent authority's master case identifier, qualified by register and jurisdiction.
Governed globally resolvable authorization-case IRI with authority binding.
Dimension UUID or ULID when no external identifier exists.
artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Use RFC 3339 timestamps with seconds and offset or Z; separate submission, receipt, assessment, decision, notification, legal-effect, observation, knowledge and ingestion times.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Use {authorization-case-id}--{artifact-kind}--{assertion-or-event-id}; never use applicant, permit number, title, date or hash alone.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Store digest, media type, issuer, legal-source and profile versions, authority, source anchors, valid and knowledge times, quality, confidentiality, licence and access marking.

policies: Only a competent authority may issue a decision or establish its legal effect; automation may validate and recommend but cannot invent competence.
A successful process, payment, submitted evidence, status page or decision copy never alone proves a current external grant.
Criteria, evidence, inspections, enforcement and appeal records remain in their authoritative masters and are referenced with purpose and freshness.
Agents may perform reversible clerical actions and propose findings; final decisions, adverse actions, sensitive disclosure and disposition require accountable authority.

read: Resolve Dimension, jurisdiction, case register, competent authority, service and requirement versions, current revision, legal time and access purpose.
create: Create case identity, class, authority, legal basis, applicant roles, requested scope and explicit unknowns before assessment or decision.
update: Append submission, evidence-use, finding, consultation, decision or event with actor, authority, reason, time and provenance; never overwrite cited history.
delete: Apply appeal, legal hold and records policy; prefer withdrawal, closure or tombstone and never cascade to applicants, evidence, grants or enforcement records.

roles.name: Authorization authority
responsibilities: Own case identity, competence, procedure and authority-qualified decisions.

roles.name: Applicant or representative
responsibilities: Submit declarations and evidence and receive notices and reasons under applicable access rights.

roles.name: Caseworker
responsibilities: Validate completeness, manage communications and preserve procedural history.

roles.name: Assessor or consultee
responsibilities: Produce criterion findings or opinions with method, evidence and conflict disclosure.

roles.name: Accountable decider
responsibilities: Issue signed reasoned decisions within delegated competence.

roles.name: Rights-register steward
responsibilities: Own the permission-bearing grant and its authoritative current status outside this case model.

roles.name: Access and records steward
responsibilities: Apply casefile disclosure, retention, legal hold and audit policy.

access.default_rule: Deny mutation and casefile disclosure unless authority, role, purpose and field policy grant it; public verification must use the external grant master and disclose minimum necessary data.
exceptions: Statutory disclosure, appeal, oversight or emergency access cites authority and remains purpose-bound, attributable and reviewable.
audit_requirements: Log actor, agent, role, purpose, case, operation, policy, RFC 3339 time, authority, affected fields, external references and outcome.

read_order: Read Dimension authorization, rights-register, legal-source, requirement, evidence, due-process, access and retention policies.
Read this model and linked party, authority, service, legal instrument, grant, evidence, payment, inspection, enforcement and appeal models before mutation.

coverage.claim: Covers a governed permit or authorization application and decision case from identity and requested scope through evidence, assessment, decision, follow-on action and exchange.

checklist.notes: Authority-qualified case identity is separated from application revisions, decisions and external grants.
Permit, licence, approval, registration, exemption and certificate classes are jurisdiction-qualified.
Requested scope, submissions, criteria, findings, decisions, reasons, deadlines and case states are first-class.
Receipts, evidence-use, verification, assessment, signature and notification evidence are covered.
Open, submit, verify, assess, consult, decide, notify, review, project and close operations are governed.
Parties, authorities, services, laws, criteria, evidence, payments, inspections, enforcement, appeals and grants retain external masters.
Submission, cure, review, decision, notification, follow-on action, closure and retention preserve history.
Actor roles, requirement-evidence links, consultations, decisions, appeals and grant references are typed.
Submission, receipt, assessment, decision, notification, effect, observation and knowledge times remain distinct.
Requested place and territorial jurisdiction are referenced without importing geographic masters.
Application derivation, evidence use, assessment method, decision authority and publication remain attributable.
Authorization case, rights register, evidence, payment, inspection and enforcement masters remain separate.
Identity, competence, completeness, criteria, evidence, reasons, legal time, appeal, access and stale-head checks are explicit.
Applicant, regulator, public, statistical and sector views are purpose-bound.
Submissions, findings, decisions, appeals, external grant links and tombstones are preserved.
CPSV-AP, CCCEV, LegalRuleML and UN/CEFACT sector projections are loss-aware.

known_omissions: No independent Claude or Grok result was available; later administrative-law and sector review is required before canonical promotion.
Jurisdiction-specific licensing, due-process, appeal, automatic-decision, fee, inspection, sanction and grant-identity profiles require specialist review.
The frozen relation ledger contains no approved WM-POL-004 rows; all composition targets remain draft.
Certified CPSV-AP, CCCEV, LegalRuleML and sector-message crosswalks and conformance fixtures remain future work.
conflicts: The legacy model owns the application-to-decision process, while the permission-bearing grant remains an external right or attestation master.
Application status and current grant status can disagree and must not be inferred from one another.
Permit, licence, approval, registration, exemption and certificate classifications vary by jurisdiction and sector.
regional_assumptions: CPSV-AP, CCCEV and the Single Digital Gateway provide European interoperability patterns rather than universal administrative law.
UN/CEFACT FLAP is a fishing-sector profile and cannot define every permit process.
LegalRuleML represents legal and deontic semantics but does not create authority or a binding decision.
adversarial_checks: Reject a case identified solely by applicant, permit number, requested activity, date or file hash.
Reject a successful workflow, payment or evidence submission represented as a valid external grant.
Reject an automated recommendation treated as a competent authority decision.
Reject revocation, suspension, renewal or transfer inferred from monitoring without authoritative event and grant update.
Reject public verification that exposes protected case data or omits jurisdiction, scope, freshness and grant-master source.
